reasoning_evidence: Signed IA Exhibit B (sources/..._p33.png, p34.png): In-Service 32mo / Trial Operation 33mo / Scheduled COD 34mo from Execution Date 2024-10-02 -> contractual Scheduled COD = 2027-08-02

Queue COD history (timeline.md) held 2027-07-15 from the 2024-12 snapshot through 2026-04 -- matches the contractual calc within ~2 weeks, i.e. the queue faithfully tracked the signed IA for 16 months

Current queue COD 2027-11-30 (since the 2026-05 snapshot) is a ~4-month slip beyond the signed contractual schedule; puct.py search 'Northington' returns exactly 1 filing (the original IA) -- NO amendment exists on PUCT docket 35077 to contractually support this later date

FIS not yet approved as of the 2026-06 snapshot despite being requested 2023-02 (~3.3 years pending) -- an unusual, unexplained regulatory delay that is the more likely true schedule risk than the COD date itself

Not in EIA-860M (eia_history.py, confirmed 2026-07-20) -- no independent second-source cross-check available; consistent with pre-construction/pre-financing stage, not necessarily paper-project evidence
No construction imagery obtainable this session (CDSE credits exhausted) -- independent estimate rests on contractual-schedule analysis alone, not on observed build pace

Verdict: lean toward the countersigned contractual date (2027-Q3) over the self-reported 2027-Q4 queue claim, since the latter has no paper trail yet; flag medium drift risk given the stalled FIS and the unexplained slip
